In this video, I have combined everything I learned about Data Modeling from my 12 years of industry experience working on real-world data engineering and analytics projects.
Data modeling is one of the most important topics for Data Engineering Interviews and Day-to-Day Data Platform Work
In this course, we will not only understand the theoretical concepts of data modeling, but we will also implement everything with real hands-on examples exactly like it is done in actual projects.
